zh_CN: 影像室里，芹香放大了显示器上的腹部 CT，一张张切换切片。
en: In the imaging room, Serika enlarges the abdominal CT on her monitor and scrolls through the slices.

zh_CN: 「这一处阴影，你为什么没有写成病灶？」
en: “Why didn't you identify this shadow as a lesion?”

zh_CN: 「因为换个层面它就不在了。先看完整组，别只挑最吓人的一张。」
en: “Because it disappears on another slice. Look at the entire series first. Don't just pick the scariest image.”

zh_CN: 「……说得像我故意来找可怕的东西一样。」
en: “...You make it sound like I came looking for something frightening.”

zh_CN: 「你把这张截图打印出来，还用红笔圈了三道。」
en: “You printed that screenshot and circled it three times in red.”

zh_CN: 「这叫重视疑点。」
en: “That's called taking a suspicious finding seriously.”

zh_CN: 「那也得看看前后切片。你看，这一层已经接不上了。」
en: “You still need to check the adjacent slices. Look, it no longer lines up on this one.”

zh_CN: 影像翻页。芹香用光标沿正常组织边缘缓缓划过。
en: The image advances. Serika slowly traces the edge of normal tissue with the cursor.

zh_CN: 「部分容积效应？」
en: “Partial volume effect?”

zh_CN: 「有可能。光凭这一层，不能当作确定的病灶。」
en: “Possibly. We can't call it a definite lesion based on this slice alone.”

zh_CN: 「那术前评估时，你会怎么建议？」
en: “Then what would you recommend for the preoperative assessment?”

zh_CN: 「把整组图像和病史对起来看。现在还不到下结论的时候。」
en: “Compare the entire series with the patient's history. It's too early to draw a conclusion.”

zh_CN: 「好。我把既往片子和病历再核一遍。」
en: “All right. I'll check the previous scans against the chart again.”

zh_CN: 「还有，那张画满红圈的打印纸，先放一边。」
en: “And put that printout covered in red circles aside for now.”

zh_CN: 「……看来我多画了两圈。」
en: “...Looks like I drew two circles too many.”

zh_CN: 芹香看了他一眼，把下一张影像调上屏幕。嘴角几乎不可察地动了一下。
en: Serika glances at him and brings up the next image. The corner of her mouth moves almost imperceptibly.

zh_CN: 屏幕上是增强扫描与血管重建图，芹香早已标好了关键位置。
en: Contrast-enhanced scans and vascular reconstructions fill the screen. Serika has already marked the key areas.

zh_CN: 「这里的血管走向，比我预计的要靠近术野。」
en: “This vessel runs closer to the operative field than I expected.”

zh_CN: 「所以我特意标出来了。你们上台以后，最好别假装没看过。」
en: “That's why I marked it. Once you're in surgery, you'd better not pretend you never saw it.”

zh_CN: 「你这话说得像我一定会忘似的。」
en: “You make it sound like I'm bound to forget.”

zh_CN: 「我已经在报告里提醒过了。真出血了，我可没法隔着屏幕替你止。」
en: “I've already flagged it in the report. If it starts bleeding, I can't stop it for you through a screen.”

zh_CN: 「按我原来的入路，恐怕很难把它暴露清楚。」
en: “With my original approach, getting a clear view of it would be difficult.”

zh_CN: 「那就得提前调整牵开的方向。让助手先把这一侧暴露出来，才好确认分支的位置。」
en: “Then adjust the direction of retraction beforehand. Have your assistant expose this side first so you can locate the branch.”

zh_CN: 光标移向血管旁的组织间隙。
en: The cursor moves to the tissue plane beside the vessel.

zh_CN: 「……你连助手站位都考虑了？」
en: “...You've even thought about where the assistant should stand?”

zh_CN: 「给外科看的报告，总得让你们知道上台后要留意什么。」
en: “A report for surgeons should tell you what to watch for during the operation.”

zh_CN: 「我本来打算先从另一侧游离。」
en: “I'd planned to start dissecting from the other side.”

zh_CN: 「既然术前看见了这条分支，就别等它成了术中的意外。」
en: “Since we've spotted this branch before surgery, don't let it become an intraoperative surprise.”

zh_CN: 「听你这么说，我差点以为你打算一起上台。」
en: “Hearing you say that, I almost thought you were planning to join us.”

zh_CN: 「会看术野，不代表我要上台。」
en: “Knowing how to read an operative field doesn't mean I'm going into one.”

zh_CN: 「我明白。我会重新调整计划。」
en: “I understand. I'll revise the plan.”

zh_CN: 「改完给我看看。我得确认那几处标记没有白做。」
en: “Show me when you're done. I need to know those markings weren't wasted.”

zh_CN: 芹香恢复工作状态，继续核对图像标记。
en: Serika returns to work, continuing to check the image annotations.

zh_CN: 屏幕并排显示了手术前后的影像，芹香正在核对变化。
en: Preoperative and postoperative images sit side by side on the screen as Serika checks the changes.

zh_CN: 「术后的片子恢复得这么整齐，倒有点不像真的。」
en: “The postoperative scan looks so clean it's almost hard to believe.”

zh_CN: 「我刚来这里时也以为是片子拿错了。后来查得多了，就知道不是档案的问题。」
en: “When I first came here, I thought someone had pulled the wrong scan too. After checking enough of them, I realized it wasn't a filing error.”

zh_CN: 「你一开始也觉得是拿错片子？」
en: “You thought it was the wrong scan at first too?”

zh_CN: 「当然。看到这种反差，先排除病人信息或检查时间弄错，才是正常反应。」
en: “Of course. With that much of a difference, checking the patient details and scan dates first is the normal response.”

zh_CN: 「核对过？」
en: “Did you check them?”

zh_CN: 「姓名、病历号、检查时间，还有手术记录，都对得上。」
en: “Name, chart number, scan dates, even the operative notes. Everything matches.”

zh_CN: 「那只好把它叫作‘星见式恢复’了。」
en: “Then I suppose we'll have to call it ‘Hoshimi-style recovery.’”

zh_CN: 「这种词千万别写进正式病历。」
en: “Don't ever put that in an official chart.”

zh_CN: 「你怎么知道我刚才没这么想？」
en: “How do you know I wasn't just thinking of doing that?”

zh_CN: 「即使恢复得快，也不能拿漂亮的片子代替随访。症状、检查和实际活动能力还是要看。」
en: “Even with rapid recovery, a nice-looking scan is no substitute for follow-up. We still need to assess symptoms, examination findings, and actual function.”

zh_CN: 「明白。恢复再快，也不能省复查。」
en: “Understood. Fast recovery doesn't mean we can skip follow-up.”

zh_CN: 「尤其不能随便再拍一套片子，就为了证明它是真的。」
en: “And especially not order another whole set of scans just to prove it's real.”

zh_CN: 「放心，我还没离谱到那一步。」
en: “Don't worry. I haven't gone that far off the rails.”

zh_CN: 她把病人的随访预约标上日期，没有回答命名请求。
en: She marks the date of the patient's follow-up appointment without responding to his proposed name.

zh_CN: 芹香把屏幕切到术后组织改变的部分，等待坂口继续看。
en: Serika brings up the postoperative tissue changes on the screen and waits for Sakaguchi to keep looking.

zh_CN: 「这里的形态不太对。我担心是新的病变。」
en: “The shape here isn't right. I'm concerned this might be a new lesion.”

zh_CN: 「你手里那份病历，往前翻两页。」
en: “Turn back two pages in that chart you're holding.”

zh_CN: 「两年前有一次腹部手术……等等。」
en: “Abdominal surgery two years ago... Wait.”

zh_CN: 「做过手术的地方，本来就不会长得像标准解剖图。」
en: “An area that's been operated on isn't going to look like a textbook anatomy diagram.”

zh_CN: 「当时的记录很简略。」
en: “The notes from that operation are very brief.”

zh_CN: 「所以报告里我只写了‘考虑术后改变，建议对照既往影像’。病史不全，就不能把话说死。」
en: “That's why my report only says ‘possible postoperative changes; comparison with prior imaging recommended.’ With an incomplete history, we can't be definitive.”

zh_CN: 「至少目前不能仅凭影像下结论。」
en: “At least for now, imaging alone isn't enough to reach a conclusion.”

zh_CN: 「嗯。她现在有什么症状？疼痛的位置和以前一样吗？」
en: “Right. What symptoms does she have now? Is the pain in the same place as before?”

zh_CN: 「我还没向她问得那么细。」
en: “I haven't asked her in that much detail yet.”

zh_CN: 「那我们盯着的，可能只是她手术后一直存在的变化。」
en: “Then what we're looking at may simply be a change that's been there ever since her surgery.”

zh_CN: 「你说得对。我去重新核对症状和旧手术记录。」
en: “You're right. I'll check her symptoms and the old operative notes again.”

zh_CN: 「旧片子也一起找。诊断室不负责替病历室猜谜。」
en: “Find the old scans too. Diagnostics isn't here to guess what the records department might know.”

zh_CN: 「看来这一个小时得从头开始。」
en: “Looks like I'll have to start this hour over.”

zh_CN: 「至少这次开始的方向是对的。」
en: “At least this time you're starting in the right direction.”

zh_CN: 坂口收起不完整的材料。芹香将待核对项写成简短清单。
en: Sakaguchi gathers the incomplete documents. Serika writes a short checklist of what needs checking.

zh_CN: 推车声从影像室门外传来。芹香注意到坂口夹在病历中的明日手术安排。
en: A cart rattles past the imaging room door. Serika notices tomorrow's surgical schedule tucked into Sakaguchi's charts.

zh_CN: 「你在看我的排班表？」
en: “Are you looking at my schedule?”

zh_CN: 「它挡在影像报告前面。」
en: “It's in front of the imaging report.”

zh_CN: 「那先看报告吧。」
en: “Then let's look at the report first.”

zh_CN: 「第二台的器械护士，和第一台负责收尾的是同一个人。」
en: “The scrub nurse for the second case is the same person finishing up the first.”

zh_CN: 「我正想问护士长，两台之间只隔十分钟，能不能接得上。」
en: “I was just going to ask the nurse manager whether a ten-minute gap would be enough.”

zh_CN: 「她得清点器械、完成交接，还要重新刷手。十分钟太紧了。」
en: “She has to count the instruments, finish the handover, and scrub again. Ten minutes is too tight.”

zh_CN: 「看来不能光靠第一台准时结束。」
en: “So we can't just count on the first case ending on time.”

zh_CN: 「医院不能靠每个人都碰巧准时来运行。」
en: “A hospital can't run on everyone happening to be on time.”

zh_CN: 「你以前排过手术表？」
en: “Have you put together surgical schedules before?”

zh_CN: 「看得懂安排，有那么稀奇吗？」
en: “Is being able to read one so remarkable?”

zh_CN: 「没有。只是连巡回护士的交接都考虑到，挺少见的。」
en: “No. It's just unusual for someone to consider even the circulating nurse's handover.”

zh_CN: 「还有病人的禁食时间和等待时间。你只写了上台时间。」
en: “There's also the patient's fasting time and waiting time. You've only listed the operation's start time.”

zh_CN: 「……我去找护理组确认衔接。」
en: “...I'll check the handover arrangements with the nursing team.”

zh_CN: 「先问她们是否愿意这么排。不是把人名挪到空格里就算安排好了。」
en: “First ask whether they're willing to work that schedule. Moving names into empty boxes doesn't mean you've arranged everything.”

zh_CN: 「好。那这份影像报告——」
en: “All right. Now, about this imaging report—”

zh_CN: 「终于想起来了？翻到下一页。」
en: “Finally remembered it? Turn the page.”

zh_CN: 芹香回到屏幕，语气重新变得公事公办。
en: Serika returns to the screen, her tone becoming businesslike again.

zh_CN: 芹香一边翻看图像，一边无意识地低声说出了接下来的牵开与器械准备。
en: As Serika studies the images, she unconsciously murmurs the next retraction steps and instruments to prepare.

zh_CN: 「你刚才是在说下一步该用什么器械？」
en: “Were you just saying which instrument to use next?”

zh_CN: 「……我说出声了？」
en: “...Did I say that aloud?”

zh_CN: 「嗯。连助手该往哪边牵开都说出来了。」
en: “Yes. Even which way the assistant should retract.”

zh_CN: 「按现在的入路，到了这一层，视野会突然变窄。」
en: “With the current approach, the view will narrow suddenly when you reach this layer.”

zh_CN: 「如果先暴露这一层呢？」
en: “What if we expose this layer first?”

zh_CN: 「视野会好一些。不过主刀得换个操作角度，器械护士也要提前准备合适的牵开器。」
en: “That would improve the view. But the lead surgeon would need a different working angle, and the scrub nurse should have the right retractor ready.”

zh_CN: 「你比我更快想到第三步。」
en: “You got to step three before I did.”

zh_CN: 「只是以前留下的习惯。不代表——」
en: “It's just an old habit. It doesn't mean—”

zh_CN: 「我知道。你现在是影像科医生。」
en: “I know. You're a radiologist now.”

zh_CN: 「我只是请你帮我完善术前方案，没打算替你决定以后做什么。」
en: “I'm only asking for your help refining the preoperative plan. I'm not trying to decide what you should do next.”

zh_CN: 「你倒是比我预想的更明白这一点。」
en: “You understand that better than I expected.”

zh_CN: 「这算夸奖吗？」
en: “Is that a compliment?”

zh_CN: 「算你今天少说了一句多余的话。」
en: “Let's say you managed one fewer unnecessary remark today.”

zh_CN: 「那我趁现在记下来。」
en: “Then I'd better write that down while I can.”

zh_CN: 「记步骤，不要记我的评语。」
en: “Write down the steps, not my comments.”

zh_CN: 她重新把图像放大，主动补了两条手术提醒。
en: She enlarges the image again and volunteers two more surgical reminders.

zh_CN: 一张检查申请单夹在影像资料里，上面有护士手写的说明。
en: An examination request with a nurse's handwritten note is tucked among the imaging documents.

zh_CN: 「报告有什么问题吗？」
en: “Is there a problem with the report?”

zh_CN: 「没有。只是申请单上写着‘患者反复询问是否一定要开刀’。」
en: “No. It's just that the request says, ‘Patient repeatedly asks whether surgery is absolutely necessary.’”

zh_CN: 「她很怕。护士说解释过好几次了。」
en: “She's frightened. The nurse says they've explained it several times.”

zh_CN: 「她问的是‘一定要’，你们回答的大概是‘怎么做’。」
en: “She's asking ‘must I?’ You're probably answering ‘how.’”

zh_CN: 「……听起来的确不是同一个问题。」
en: “...Those really aren't the same question.”

zh_CN: 「你把技术路线讲得越熟练，她可能越觉得自己没有提问的余地。」
en: “The more smoothly you explain the procedure, the more she may feel there's no room left to ask questions.”

zh_CN: 「那你觉得该怎么说？」
en: “Then how do you think I should explain it?”

zh_CN: 「先说明为什么建议手术，不做会有什么风险。然后让她把担心的事问完。」
en: “Start with why you recommend surgery and the risks of not having it. Then let her ask about everything that's worrying her.”

zh_CN: 「你以前很擅长安慰患者？」
en: “Were you good at reassuring patients?”

zh_CN: 「不一定。我只是记得有些病人嘴上说‘知道了’，手一直在发抖。」
en: “Not necessarily. I just remember some patients saying ‘I understand’ while their hands kept shaking.”

zh_CN: 「那今天我去见她的时候，先把她的问题听完。」
en: “Then when I see her today, I'll hear her questions out first.”

zh_CN: 「她重复问几次，也别急着催。」
en: “And don't rush her if she asks the same thing several times.”

zh_CN: 「放心，我会留时间。」
en: “Don't worry. I'll make time.”

zh_CN: 「……这样就好。」
en: “...Good.”

zh_CN: 「你提醒得很及时。谢谢。」
en: “That was a timely reminder. Thank you.”

zh_CN: 芹香没有回应评价，只把申请单重新夹好；看屏幕时的表情稍微柔和。
en: Serika does not respond to the praise. She simply clips the request back into place, her expression a little softer as she looks at the screen.

zh_CN: 坂口带来一张转运交接单。芹香认出了上午栏位里的护士签名。
en: Sakaguchi brings a transfer handover form. Serika recognizes the nurse's signature in the morning entry.

zh_CN: 「这张交接单有什么问题吗？」
en: “Is something wrong with this handover form?”

zh_CN: 「单子本身没问题。我在意的是同一个护士的签名。」
en: “The form itself is fine. It's the same nurse's signature that concerns me.”

zh_CN: 「怎么了？」
en: “What about it?”

zh_CN: 「凌晨两点来补资料的是她。今天上午负责转运交接的，还是她。」
en: “She was the one bringing additional records at two in the morning. And she's handling the transfer handover again this morning.”

zh_CN: 「我记得她昨晚在值班。」
en: “I remember she was on duty last night.”

zh_CN: 「能干不等于一个人可以按两个人使用。」
en: “Being capable doesn't mean one person can do the work of two.”

zh_CN: 「你怎么还记得昨晚是谁来送的资料？」
en: “How do you still remember who brought the records last night?”

zh_CN: 「她昨晚替我找过一份旧片。脸色很差，今天还是她。」
en: “She found an old scan for me last night. She looked exhausted, and today it's still her.”

zh_CN: 「我去和护士长确认一下排班。」
en: “I'll check the schedule with the nurse manager.”

zh_CN: 「别只是夸她辛苦。让安排这张表的人知道，问题出在排班上。」
en: “Don't just praise her hard work. Make sure whoever drew up that roster knows the problem is the scheduling.”

zh_CN: 「你对这种事，好像很有办法。」
en: “You seem to know how to handle this kind of thing.”

zh_CN: 「没有办法的人，也该把问题指出来。」
en: “Even people who don't know how to fix it should point out the problem.”

zh_CN: 「那我去处理。晚点告诉你结果。」
en: “Then I'll deal with it. I'll let you know how it goes.”

zh_CN: 「……我是影像科，不是你的行政督导。」
en: “...I'm a radiologist, not your administrative supervisor.”

zh_CN: 「知道。不过你发现了，我总该给你个交代。」
en: “I know. But you spotted it. I ought to tell you what happens.”

zh_CN: 「那就别只停在嘴上。」
en: “Then do more than talk about it.”

zh_CN: 她转回报告，脸上隐约有一丝无奈。
en: She turns back to the report, a faint look of exasperation on her face.

zh_CN: 芹香翻开磨旧的手写笔记，在最后一页画下影像里的组织走向。
en: Serika opens a worn handwritten notebook and sketches the course of the tissues on its last page.

zh_CN: 「你画得真快。」
en: “You draw quickly.”

zh_CN: 「看这种结构，文字说明太费时间。」
en: “Explaining this kind of structure in words takes too long.”

zh_CN: 「这页上已经有相似的图了？」
en: “There's already a similar drawing on this page?”

zh_CN: 「以前记下来的。手画一遍，之后就不容易忘。」
en: “Something I noted down before. Draw it once by hand, and it's harder to forget.”

zh_CN: 「器械顺序也写在旁边……这是外科医生的笔记吧。」
en: “The instrument sequence is written beside it too... This is a surgeon's notebook, isn't it?”

zh_CN: 「以前确实是。现在用来看影像，也一样有用。」
en: “It used to be. It's just as useful for reading scans now.”

zh_CN: 「刚才那句话有点唐突。抱歉。」
en: “That was a little thoughtless of me. Sorry.”
“...It's all right.”

zh_CN: 「……能问一句吗？你为什么还留着它？」
en: “...May I ask why you still keep it?”

zh_CN: 「因为上面的东西没有做错。就算我不打算重新走那条路，也没必要假装自己没学过。」
en: “Because nothing in it was wrong. Even if I don't intend to go down that path again, I don't have to pretend I never learned any of it.”

zh_CN: 「我明白了。抱歉，刚才问得太多。」
en: “I understand. Sorry for asking so much.”

zh_CN: 「没事。我只是没想好该怎么说。」
en: “It's fine. I just hadn't worked out how to put it.”

zh_CN: 「那我们先把这一段的入路确认完。」
en: “Then let's finish confirming the approach for this section.”

zh_CN: 「这张示意图你可以拍下来。术前应该用得上。」
en: “You can photograph this diagram. It should help with your preparations.”

zh_CN: 「谢谢。笔记本我不动。」
en: “Thank you. I won't touch the notebook.”

zh_CN: 「本来也没打算借你。字太乱了。」
en: “I wasn't going to lend it to you anyway. The handwriting's too messy.”

zh_CN: 芹香关上笔记本，但没有立即收进抽屉，而是留在桌边。
en: Serika closes the notebook but leaves it at the edge of the desk instead of putting it straight into the drawer.

zh_CN: 病例已经讨论完毕。归档时，坂口注意到桌角有一本夹着书签的随笔集。
en: The case discussion is finished. While filing the records, Sakaguchi notices a bookmarked essay collection at the corner of the desk.

zh_CN: 「今天结束得比预计早。」
en: “We finished earlier than expected today.”

zh_CN: 「今天的片子不难，而且你终于把病历带齐了。」
en: “Today's scans weren't difficult, and you finally brought the complete chart.”

zh_CN: 「这是在夸我？」
en: “Is that a compliment?”

zh_CN: 「只是陈述事实。」
en: “Just a statement of fact.”

zh_CN: 「那是什么书？不像医学文献。」
en: “What's that book? It doesn't look like medical literature.”

zh_CN: 「一本随笔。借来看的。」
en: “An essay collection. I borrowed it.”

zh_CN: 「你也喜欢看随笔？」
en: “You like essays too?”

zh_CN: 「偶尔。盯了一天屏幕，总想看看别的。」
en: “Occasionally. After staring at a screen all day, I want to look at something else.”

zh_CN: 「说得也是。平时休假也喜欢看书？」
en: “Fair enough. Do you like reading on your days off too?”

zh_CN: 「有时候。安静、不会突然有人叫我去看新的片子，就不错。」
en: “Sometimes. Quiet, with no one suddenly calling me over to look at another scan. That'll do.”

zh_CN: 「这听起来像很低的休假标准。」
en: “That sounds like a pretty low standard for a day off.”

zh_CN: 「对我来说已经够了。你呢？休假时还会想手术安排吗？」
en: “It's enough for me. What about you? Do you still think about surgical schedules on your days off?”

zh_CN: 「偶尔会。然后发现自己好像根本没休假。」
en: “Sometimes. Then I realize I haven't really taken the day off at all.”

zh_CN: 「那你的标准也不高。」
en: “Your standards aren't very high either, then.”

zh_CN: 「看来我下次休假得试试真正休息。」
en: “Looks like I should try actually resting next time.”

zh_CN: 「那就先学会准时下班。其他的慢慢来。」
en: “Start by learning to leave work on time. The rest can come later.”

zh_CN: 她重新拿起那本书，坂口收好病例离开。双方没有约定私下会面。
en: She picks up the book again, and Sakaguchi gathers his charts and leaves. They make no plans to meet privately.

zh_CN: 芹香在增强 CT 的重建图上做了两处标记，坂口的视线停在一条血管分支上。
en: Serika makes two marks on the contrast-enhanced CT reconstruction. Sakaguchi's gaze rests on a vascular branch.

zh_CN: 「你在这里多标了一处。是担心这条细小的血管分支？」
en: “You've added a mark here. Are you concerned about this small vascular branch?”

zh_CN: 「……我还没说，你就看出来了。」
en: “...You noticed before I said anything.”

zh_CN: 「前几次被你提醒过，现在我会先看这里。」
en: “You've pointed it out before. Now I check here first.”

zh_CN: 「方向没错。不过这次更要注意的是它后面的组织间隙。」
en: “You're on the right track. But this time, pay closer attention to the tissue plane behind it.”

zh_CN: 「嗯。先确认层次，再决定从哪一侧进入。」
en: “Right. Confirm the layers first, then decide which side to approach from.”

zh_CN: 「这样我就不用从第一张解释到最后一张了。」
en: “That saves me explaining every image from first to last.”

zh_CN: 「听起来你还有点失望？」
en: “You sound almost disappointed.”

zh_CN: 「我只是觉得，跟你讨论终于省事了一些。」
en: “I just think discussing cases with you has finally become a little less work.”

zh_CN: 「那正式报告也可以少写两行？」
en: “Then can you leave a couple of lines out of the official report too?”

zh_CN: 「当然不行。我能少对你解释几句，不代表报告可以少写。」
en: “Of course not. Having less to explain to you doesn't mean I can write less in the report.”

zh_CN: 「说得也是。我把修改过的术前计划发你确认。」
en: “Fair point. I'll send you the revised preoperative plan to check.”

zh_CN: 「你知道我会看。」
en: “You know I'll read it.”

zh_CN: 「知道。不过我还是想先问你一声。」
en: “I do. But I still wanted to ask first.”

zh_CN: 「……发过来吧。今天下班前我会看完。」
en: “...Send it over. I'll read it before I leave today.”

zh_CN: 芹香继续调取下一层影像。这次她没有等坂口开口，就主动切到了他要看的位置。
en: Serika brings up the next slice. This time she moves to the area Sakaguchi wants to see before he asks.

zh_CN: 坂口带来准备手术的病例。芹香指着影像里一条细小的血管分支。
en: Sakaguchi brings a case scheduled for surgery. Serika points to a small vascular branch in the image.

zh_CN: 「你标的地方，实际到了术野里，可能需要助手从旁边确认。」
en: “Once we're in the operative field, an assistant may need to confirm the area you've marked from the side.”

zh_CN: 「影像只能告诉你它大致在哪里。真正上台，还得看当时的暴露情况。」
en: “Imaging can only tell you roughly where it is. In surgery, it'll depend on how well the field is exposed.”

zh_CN: 「我也是这么想的。所以先来问问你。」
en: “That's what I thought. So I came to ask you first.”

zh_CN: 「……你想让我担任这台的助手？」
en: “...You want me to assist on this case?”

zh_CN: 「如果你觉得有必要。我不想只因为你能做，就每台都叫上你。」
en: “If you think it's necessary. I don't want to call you into every operation just because you can do it.”

zh_CN: 「别说得像我连讨论这个都承受不了。」
en: “Don't make it sound like I can't even handle discussing it.”

zh_CN: 「我知道你不喜欢手术室。」
en: “I know you don't like the operating room.”

zh_CN: 「现在也不喜欢。但我说过，真正需要的时候可以帮忙。」
en: “I still don't. But I said I'd help when I'm genuinely needed.”

zh_CN: 「那这台呢？」
en: “What about this case, then?”

zh_CN: 「这条分支如果影响操作，我在助手位上或许能帮你更快确认。」
en: “If that branch interferes with the procedure, I may be able to help you identify it faster from the assistant's position.”

zh_CN: 「我把术前计划和团队分工发给你。」
en: “I'll send you the preoperative plan and the team's assignments.”

zh_CN: 「嗯。该做的准备照常做，不用特殊对待。」
en: “All right. Make the usual preparations. No special treatment.”

zh_CN: 「还有你自己的排班。我先跟影像科确认，不占你的检查时间。」
en: “And your own schedule. I'll check with radiology first so it doesn't cut into your examinations.”

zh_CN: 「……这点倒是终于记得问了。」
en: “...You finally remembered to ask about that.”

zh_CN: 她在计划上补了一处提醒，然后把文件递还给坂口。
en: She adds a reminder to the plan, then hands the document back to Sakaguchi.

zh_CN: 术后复查影像显示在屏幕上。芹香判断完毕，却没有马上结束谈话。
en: Postoperative follow-up images fill the screen. Serika has finished her assessment but does not end the conversation immediately.

zh_CN: 「复查片看起来不错。报告有什么要补充的吗？」
en: “The follow-up scan looks good. Anything to add to the report?”

zh_CN: 「影像上暂时没有新的异常。不过病人问了我一件事。」
en: “There are no new abnormalities on the images for now. But the patient asked me something.”

zh_CN: 「问你？」
en: “Asked you?”

zh_CN: 「她想知道什么时候能回去开店。说店里的人每天都在问。」
en: “She wants to know when she can go back to running her shop. She says the people there ask every day.”

zh_CN: 「这得结合伤口、体力和恢复情况判断。光看片子不能决定。」
en: “That depends on her wound, stamina, and recovery. We can't decide from the scans alone.”

zh_CN: 「所以我没有替你答应。」
en: “That's why I didn't promise anything on your behalf.”

zh_CN: 「谢谢。我查完恢复情况，会亲自跟她说。」
en: “Thank you. I'll assess her recovery and speak to her myself.”

zh_CN: 「她担心的好像不只是自己恢复得慢。店里的事情，她放不下。」
en: “I don't think slow recovery is her only worry. She can't stop thinking about the shop.”

zh_CN: 「你记得倒很清楚。」
en: “You remember it quite clearly.”

zh_CN: 「她前后提了三次。」
en: “She brought it up three times.”

zh_CN: 「我以前总觉得，你看完影像就不会再管这些了。」
en: “I used to think you wouldn't concern yourself with things like that once you'd read the scans.”

zh_CN: 「我又不是只看得到屏幕上的东西。」
en: “It's not as if I can only see what's on the screen.”

zh_CN: 「是我想错了。以后这种话，我会认真听。」
en: “I had the wrong idea. I'll listen properly to things like that from now on.”

zh_CN: 「……那我就不算白说。」
en: “...Then I haven't said it for nothing.”

zh_CN: 芹香完成报告，临关闭页面前又确认了一眼患者的复查预约。
en: Serika finishes the report and checks the patient's follow-up appointment once more before closing the page.

zh_CN: 午后的影像室里，休息桌上放着两包独立包装的饼干。
en: It is afternoon in the imaging room. Two individually wrapped packets of biscuits sit on the break table.

zh_CN: 「抱歉，打扰你休息了。」
en: “Sorry to interrupt your break.”

zh_CN: 「我正准备休息。你今天吃过午饭了吗？」
en: “I was just about to take one. Have you had lunch today?”

zh_CN: 「还没有。想着先把这份病例谈完。」
en: “Not yet. I thought I'd discuss this case first.”

zh_CN: 「你每次都这么说。」
en: “You say that every time.”

zh_CN: 「有这么明显吗？」
en: “Is it that obvious?”

zh_CN: 「你连封面朝下的病历都没发现。」
en: “You haven't even noticed your chart is face down.”
“...So it is.”

zh_CN: 「那边有饼干。先吃一点再说。」
en: “There are biscuits over there. Eat something first.”

zh_CN: 「你特意给我留的？」
en: “Did you save them for me?”

zh_CN: 「我多带了一包。你最近经常错过吃饭时间。」
en: “I brought an extra packet. You've been missing meals a lot lately.”

zh_CN: 「你注意到了？」
en: “You noticed?”

zh_CN: 「常来跟我讨论病例的人，我总看得出他有没有好好休息。」
en: “When someone comes to discuss cases with me this often, I can tell whether he's getting enough rest.”

zh_CN: 「……谢谢。我先洗个手。」
en: “...Thank you. I'll wash my hands first.”

zh_CN: 「不用急。片子不会跑。」
en: “Take your time. The scans aren't going anywhere.”

zh_CN: 坂口把病历放正，走向洗手池。芹香轻轻把那包没拆封的饼干推到桌边。
en: Sakaguchi turns the chart the right way up and walks to the sink. Serika gently slides the unopened packet of biscuits to the edge of the table.

zh_CN: 病例已经归档，坂口准备离开。芹香却没有翻开下一份报告。桌边是那本随笔。
en: The case has been filed, and Sakaguchi is preparing to leave. Serika has not opened the next report. The essay collection lies beside her.

zh_CN: 「这份病例就讨论到这里吧。」
en: “Let's leave this case there.”

zh_CN: 「嗯。正式报告稍后发你。」
en: “All right. I'll send you the official report later.”

zh_CN: 「那我先回病房了。今天也辛苦了。」
en: “Then I'll head back to the ward. Thanks for your help today.”

zh_CN: 「……坂口医生。」
en: “...Dr. Sakaguchi.”

zh_CN: 「怎么，还有别的片子？」
en: “What is it? Another scan?”

zh_CN: 「没有。你上次说休假想找本书看，后来找了吗？」
en: “No. You said you wanted to find a book for your day off. Did you?”

zh_CN: 「你还记得这件事？」
en: “You remember that?”

zh_CN: 「是你自己提的。又不是很久以前。」
en: “You're the one who brought it up. It wasn't that long ago.”

zh_CN: 「找到了。不过只读了一半。」
en: “I did. But I've only read half of it.”

zh_CN: 「至少你没整天盯着手术排班表。」
en: “At least you didn't spend the whole day staring at a surgical schedule.”

zh_CN: 「还是看了半天。后来才想起来把它收起来。」
en: “I still spent half the day on it. Then I remembered to put it away.”

zh_CN: 「那就算有进步了。」
en: “That counts as progress, then.”

zh_CN: 「你那本随笔看完了？」
en: “Have you finished that essay collection?”

zh_CN: 「看完了。你要是有兴趣，可以借给你。」
en: “I have. If you're interested, I could lend it to you.”

zh_CN: 「那下次我来影像室拿？」
en: “Shall I pick it up next time I come to the imaging room?”

zh_CN: 「……下次碰见我，提醒我一声就好。」
en: “...Just remind me next time you see me.”

zh_CN: 她低头整理书签，没有急着回到屏幕。
en: She looks down to straighten the bookmark, in no hurry to return to the screen.
